messages:
nina: Hi all, first day remote from a hotel in Spain. I can’t SSH to bastion-eu-1: `ssh nina@bastion-eu-1` just hangs. WireGuard shows connected. Any tips?
tod: welcome! :wave: does `ssh -v` show it trying IPv6? Hotels sometimes hand out IPv6-only or weird NAT.
nina: `ssh -v` shows: `Connecting to bastion-eu-1 [2604:...]:22...` then hangs. But `ping 10.45.1.1` over wg0 works (internal IPv4).
netops: aha. Our bastions currently publish AAAA records and we prefer IPv6 when present. But the bastion nodes only accept IPv4 for SSH from the WireGuard CIDR (we haven't routed IPv6 over wg). Quick workaround: force IPv4: `ssh -4 nina@bastion-eu-1`
nina: omg that worked, thanks! I can jump now.
tod: follow-up: can you post output of `wg` and `ip -6 addr show`? We want to see if your WireGuard client has an IPv6 route.
nina: wg shows remote endpoint 2001:db8::1:51820, AllowedIPs = 10.45.0.0/16, ::/0. ip -6 addr shows hotel ipv6 on eth0 and a fe80 link-local on wg0 but no routed ::/64.
netops: looks like your WG profile is trying IPv6 to the server (endpoint) but not routing IPv6 traffic through the tunnel, so outbound SSH prefers the public IPv6 path to the bastion hostname which doesn't accept SSH from that hotel IP. Two options:
1) Force SSH IPv4 as a local fix (`ssh -4`).
2) Edit /etc/hosts and pin bastion-eu-1 to its internal IPv4 (10.45.0.x) while on the tunnel: `sudo -- sh -c "echo '10.45.0.5 bastion-eu-1' >> /etc/hosts'`
3) We can update the WG profile to set `Endpoint = 1.2.3.4:51820` (IPv4) for your client template so it prefers IPv4 endpoints.
ninja (typo): infra-bot: user/nina added to onboarding group
it-support: created ticket NET-2511: "Hotel IPv6 -> bastion AAAA preference causes SSH fails for new hires" assigned to netops. We'll push a note to the onboarding guide: prefer IPv4 endpoint for WG client if client network is IPv6-only.
nina: thanks everyone. One more Q: is there a recommended ~/.ssh/config to avoid `-4` every time?
tod: add this block:
```
Host bastion-eu-1
  Hostname 10.45.0.5
  User nina
  ProxyCommand none
```
That points directly to the internal IPv4 address while you’re on the tunnel.
nina: added it and verified SSH + git clones work. Appreciate the quick help! :sparkles:
